blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla on Monday said he will order the anti-graft body to form a study group in a bid to pin down those who “gamed” the budget in the past few years. Remulla made this remark as the Supreme Court declared “unconstitutional” certain provisions of the 2024 and 2025 national budgets, as well as key unprogrammed appropriations (UA), or standby government funds, in the 2026 budget. “I will compose a group that will study the Supreme Court decision and the budget that came with the decision so we could study the details thoroughly,” Remulla said […]...
